tranches.name: Revolving Credit Facility (as amended by Amendment No. 3)
tranches.quote: The Third Amendment (i) increases the aggregate amount available under the Company’s revolving credit facility from $650.0 million to $1.5 billion, (ii) increases the amount available under the Company’s letters of credit facility from $175.0 million to $350.0 million, and (iii) extends the maturity of the revolving credit facility to May 2, 2028
